items.title: System Check: Adam Novotný's Hat Trick Leads a Big Week
items.desc: Adam Novotný had the best week of any Canucks prospect, scoring a hat trick on his way to 7 points in 3 games for the Peterborough Petes. Here is every prospect who played Oct 12-18, from Romani and Davis in the NCAA to five skaters in Abbotsford and two wins for Medvedev in London. Your weekly System Check on the Canucks pipeline.

items.title: Vancouver Canucks 2024 Draft Retrospective
items.desc: Coming off a devastating second-round exit to the Edmonton Oilers, the Vancouver Canucks entered the 2024 draft with just five picks total, no first or second rounder among them, the cost of an aggressive push to win now the season prior. Here's how that thin class is tracking two years later.
